title: Fourier coefficient bound for the mod-three function
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $S$ be a nonempty subset of the coordinates of the $n$-dimensional sign cube. The absolute value of the Fourier coefficient of the mod-three function on $S$ is at most $\frac{2}{3}\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)^n$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite set of coordinates
